name: skillator
description: Reusable agent skills (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity, Pi), named purpose-first after fantasy and sci-fi: a grayskull-power router, tickets-zordon for serialised bug/feature tickets, rules-orko for the user's standing rules at global and project scope, watch-cortana for usage-limit auto-handoff, handoff-cortana/resume-cortana for writing and executing a handoff, relay-morpheus for staged runs that outlive the session and marathons over the board, holo-r2d2 for drawing a run and its decisions, tasks-sentinels for one-fresh-agent-per-task plan execution, designui-galadriel for turning a mockup into a working app, build-jarvis for every feature, graded per seat from design to verify, design-arwen for native+web UI/UX, a11y-toph for accessibility, tui-tron for terminal UIs, spec-watson for traceable requirement ids, mergeprep-oracle/merge-smith for branch merges, deploy-merlin/deploy-niyoj for VPS deployment, audit-sherlock for a full-app forensic audit, code-yoda for restraint (the laziness ladder, an over-engineering review or audit, the shortcut-marker ledger), remote-cerebro for driving codex/cursor-agent/pi/gemini from a phone with a kill switch and pairing, live-friday for a live build/preview loop, and screenshot-argus for a test-screenshot loop
